# Allowlist for forbidden-terms CI check (Design Spec §15.2).
#
# Lines starting with `#` are comments. Each non-empty, non-comment
# line is treated as a `grep -E` (POSIX extended regex) pattern
# applied against `/tmp/forbidden-hits.txt` lines (which are in
# `path:line:content` format from `rg -n`). Any hit whose line
# matches ANY allowlist pattern is filtered out before the
# fail-on-empty check.
#
# Rules of thumb for adding entries:
#   - Path-anchored regexes are easiest: `^apps/cli/` allows the
#     entire CLI.
#   - Internal Rust doc comments (// or //!) and code comments are
#     NOT user-facing (Vite strips JS comments, rustdoc is
#     developer-only) — allowlist by path.
#   - Test files that VERIFY forbidden terms are rejected need to
#     contain them — allowlist by path.
#   - User-visible UI strings, error toasts, README/marketing copy
#     are NOT allowlistable — rewrite to comply with §15.2.

# ─── apps/cli/ is internal-only (pre-mainnet desktop is the user-
# facing surface; CLI is the developer/operator surface that gets
# replaced before mainnet). Error messages still need to mention
# "blockchain"/"gas"/"revisions" because they describe RPC and
# Foundry-wallet behavior to the operator.
#
# Narrowed to .rs + .toml suffixes (the only file types in apps/cli/
# today — Rust sources, integration tests, and the Cargo manifest).
# This way a future user-facing asset added under apps/cli/
# (HTML/CSS/Markdown user-docs/JSON config bundled with a packaged
# CLI) would NOT be silently allowlisted — that PR would have to
# explicitly broaden this entry, forcing a human decision.
^apps/cli/[^:]*\.(rs|toml):

# ─── apps/desktop/src/commands/pairing.rs: Rust `///` doc comment
# describing the `DesktopError::Chain` variant ("insufficient-gas").
# Rustdoc is developer-facing, not user-visible.
^apps/desktop/src/commands/pairing\.rs:

# ─── apps/desktop/src/ui/screens/HelpRecoverWizard.tsx: JS comments
# explaining gas-estimation race condition (audit LOW-1 fix). The
# Vite production bundle strips all `//` and `/* */` comments so
# these never reach the rendered UI.
^apps/desktop/src/ui/screens/HelpRecoverWizard\.tsx:

# ─── apps/desktop/src/ui/screens/SetupGuardiansWizard.tsx: JS
# comments describing the gas-estimate revert keyword sniffing
# (audit LOW-2 fix). Same Vite stripping as above.
^apps/desktop/src/ui/screens/SetupGuardiansWizard\.tsx:

# ─── Vitest test files for the above wizards — they assert against
# realistic Foundry error messages that contain "estimate-gas".
^apps/desktop/src/ui/screens/HelpRecoverWizard\.test\.tsx:
^apps/desktop/src/ui/screens/SetupGuardiansWizard\.test\.tsx:

# ─── Project README is developer/contributor-facing (GitHub +
# crates.io / docs.rs landing). The Design Spec §15.2 rule is
# about end-user UI surfaces (the desktop app, extension popup,
# Tauri toast text). Listed explicitly so a future audit can
# revisit if user-vs-developer scope shifts.
^README\.md:
